_meta.method: Claude-generated initial classification based on business-segment knowledge, with user overrides applied
_meta.decision_rule: Type B if 4+ independent revenue drivers operating in distinct end markets, OR if valuation reflects multi-driver optionality regardless of current revenue mix; Type A if 1-3 drivers AND one dominant driver (>80% of revenue) AND valuation pegged to that single driver
_meta.confidence_values: high | medium | low — reflects classifier's certainty about the classification, separate from the trend layer's per-call confidence
user_overrides: META: A→B (three platforms target distinct audiences)
_meta.review_status: REVIEWED — user accepted with two overrides

AAPL.rationale: iPhone, Services, Mac, iPad, Wearables/Home/Accessories, plus geographic optionality (China, India). Diversified revenue base; no single product line exceeds 60% of revenue.

ADBE.rationale: Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Experience Cloud. Three substantial independent product families with different customer bases. Low end of Type B.

AMD.rationale: Datacenter, Client (CPUs), Gaming (GPUs + semi-custom), Embedded (Xilinx). Four independent end markets.

AMPX.rationale: Silicon anode battery technology for EVs and aviation. One core thesis.

AMZN.rationale: North America Retail, International Retail, AWS, Advertising, Subscriptions (Prime + content). AWS alone is a $90B+ business; advertising is now ~$50B and growing fast.

AVGO.rationale: Networking semis, Wireless (Apple modems), Storage, Industrial, Cybersecurity (Symantec), Software (VMware/CA). Each is a multi-billion-dollar standalone business.

BAC.rationale: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management, Global Banking (IB), Global Markets. Each is a meaningful independent business line.

DIS.rationale: Parks/Experiences, Studios, Streaming (DTC), Linear TV (ESPN + Cable), Consumer Products. Parks alone is a $30B+ business.

ENPH.rationale: Microinverters + storage for residential solar. Storage is adjacent but tied to the same thesis (residential solar adoption). Single-driver.

ENVX.rationale: Silicon anode battery technology. Pre-commercial, single thesis.

EOSE.rationale: Zinc-bromide battery technology for long-duration storage. Single thesis.

FSLR.rationale: Thin-film cadmium telluride solar panels. Single product line, single end market.

GOOGL.rationale: Search ads, YouTube ads, Network (programmatic), Cloud, Other Bets (Waymo, etc.). Search still dominates but Cloud and YouTube are each $30B+ businesses.

HD.rationale: Home improvement retail. Pro vs DIY are customer segments within one business model, not independent drivers. Geographic split (US/Mexico/Canada) is similar.

JNJ.rationale: Post-Kenvue spinoff (2023): Pharma + MedTech. Only 2 drivers but each is a $50B+ business with independent dynamics. Low end of Type B; cap variable lower (~40%).

JPM.rationale: Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, Asset & Wealth Management. Four meaningfully independent businesses.

MA.rationale: Payment processing network. Many product variants (cards, B2B, real-time payments) but all variations of the core network business model.

META.rationale: USER OVERRIDE: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp target distinct audiences with different growth profiles and monetization maturities. Even though all three monetize via the same ad engine, the platforms are independent revenue drivers. Reality Labs is a 4th sub-driver but small and loss-making — excluded from count.

MSFT.rationale: Intelligent Cloud (Azure + server products), Productivity (Office/M365), More Personal Computing (Windows + Xbox), LinkedIn, AI/Copilot products. Five+ independent drivers.

NFLX.rationale: Streaming video subscriptions. Ad-tier is a pricing variation, not an independent driver. Live sports/games are content categories within the same business.

NVDA.rationale: Data Center, Gaming, Professional Visualization, Automotive. Data Center dominates (~85%+) but other segments are substantive multi-billion-$ businesses. Borderline B due to concentration; classify B but watch.

ORCL.rationale: Cloud Applications (Fusion + NetSuite), Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Hardware, License & On-Premise Database. OCI growing fast as a separate driver.

PG.rationale: Beauty, Grooming, Health Care, Home Care, Fabric Care, Baby/Family Care. Six distinct consumer-products categories with different end markets and competitive dynamics.

PYPL.rationale: Digital payments. Venmo is real but same core business model. Braintree is wholesale extension. Single thesis.

QS.rationale: Solid-state battery technology, pre-commercial. Single thesis.

RUN.rationale: Residential solar installation + financing. Storage is adjacent. Single thesis.

TSLA.rationale: USER OVERRIDE: Auto is 90%+ of current revenue but Tesla's stock valuation reflects multi-driver optionality — FSD/Robotaxi, Energy storage, Optimus, and Auto each carry independent valuation premiums in the market's pricing. Insurance is a 5th sub-driver but small. The thesis is multi-platform even when revenue isn't yet.

TTD.rationale: Demand-side platform for digital advertising. CTV is a sub-segment within the same DSP business. Single thesis.

UNH.rationale: UnitedHealthcare (insurance), Optum Health (provider services), Optum Rx (PBM), Optum Insight (analytics). Four independent businesses; the Optum segments now exceed UHG insurance in profitability.

V.rationale: Payment processing network. Multiple geographic and product variations but one core network business model.

WMT.rationale: Walmart US, Walmart International, Sam's Club, Walmart Connect (advertising), Marketplace + e-commerce. Advertising and marketplace are increasingly meaningful independent drivers.
